about: Pinned values for Eym's world (tools/world-checks.mjs). 'fixed' are invariants no tool changes: the owner's maps. 'managed' follow the world: a rebuild that moves one reports it, and node tools/world.mjs --accept-pins records the new value with a note.

registryCsvSha256.note: 0.27.0: the survey of the coasts joined the build; generators fingerprint their own groups of dials (the world's land, plates and ocean are unchanged)
